sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the promise of "you will surely listen" in the era of Mashiach and the resurrection is assured through our service, especially the refinement of the darkness of exile.

translations.translation: And this is "And it will be, because you will listen" — "you will listen" surely,
for it is a certain thing that the intention will be completed, that the Holy One, blessed be He, desired to have a dwelling place for Himself in the lower realms,
in the two aforementioned matters.
Both the revelation of Ein Sof that shone even before the tzimtzum
(the revelation of the days of Mashiach)
and the revelation of the essential concealment
(the revelation of the resurrection of the dead).
And although these revelations depend on our deeds and our service, and permission is granted to every person,
nevertheless, regarding this we are promised
that no one from among us will be rejected,
and each and every one of Israel will complete the intention through our deeds,
the effort in Torah and mitzvos beyond the nature of the animal soul,
and also in our service,
the effort in Torah and mitzvos beyond even the nature of the G-dly soul.
And this is "And it will be, because you will listen" — "because" refers
(as above)
to the heels of Mashiach,
for
(in addition to the fact that then the promise "you will surely listen" is fulfilled)
the perfection of our service
(adding a new matter even regarding the G-dly soul)
is
(primarily)
through the refinement of the darkness of exile, and particularly the darkness of the heels of Mashiach.
[And particularly according to what the Tzemach Tzedek wrote,
that "And it will be, because" is the matter of "and His hand"
grasping the heel of Esav, and he explains
(in the first explanation)
that it refers to the actual heel of Esav].
And also regarding the righteous, for whom the darkness of exile does not darken so much for them,
and certainly they do not have the service of transforming willful sins into merits,
and also the elevation accomplished through the refinement and purification of the animal soul is not so powerful for them
(because their animal soul is not so material even before the service),
nevertheless, through the trials,
and particularly through self-sacrifice in actual practice,
the sparks that are also in the concealment of the primeval light are refined as above.
And after that in many righteous people there was also the elevation of the refinement of the sparks in the concealment of the primeval light through their self-sacrifice,
behold, this elevation is also drawn down to their children
[and as it is written, "And the L-rd your G-d will keep for you... which He swore to your forefathers"],
including also these children, the students,
who learned their Torah,
therefore they no longer need trials,
and certainly not self-sacrifice in its simple sense, but rather the surrender of the will,
and there will be for them and for all the children of Israel "our deeds and our service" from a place of rest and expansion in their simple and true sense,
with joy and a good heart,
and the prophecy will be fulfilled,
"Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust," and the master of the hillula among them,
and we will all go speedily, upright, to our land with the coming of Mashiach our righteousness,
literally immediately, speedily.
